title: Kevin O'Connell: Justin Jefferson "got close" to returning, ankle to be evaluated Monday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kevin O'Connell: Justin Jefferson "got close" to returning, ankle to be evaluated Monday
sources.description: Vikings wide receiver Justin Jefferson left Sunday's game in the first quarter with an ankle injury and did not return before the end of Minnesota's 23-16 win over the Buccaneers.
